children: ChronoScale Holdings Corp reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue rising to $41.48M from $16.72M a year earlier, while the company posted a loss of ($42.48M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.29).
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue growth of 148% was driven by new customers and hardware resale arrangements.
Company refocused on Cloud GPU-as-a-Service, deploying 6,144 NVIDIA H100 GPUs across three colocation sites.
Secured strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Nutanix and Baseten to expand enterprise AI deployments.
Completed a holding-company restructure, launched a Token Factory usage-based offering, and sold the Legacy Ekso business to concentrate on cloud operations.
Received $328.2M in customer prepayments and maintains additional deployable capacity for dedicated and managed inference services.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
